note: Made by eye from label_speech.py sheets (lower half of each aligned face at 12 fps, one row per second, with a bar where Silero VAD hears speech). Rule: a face is speaking where speech is audible (Silero) and its mouth visibly articulates; a face whose mouth is still while speech is heard is a listener. Every face-frame of a labelled identity outside these intervals counts as not speaking, except inside 'unsure' intervals, which are not scored (mouth hidden by a hand or in profile, two plausible speakers, or a yell that Silero does not hear under the music). Times are seconds. Neither system being compared was run before labelling.
